lignes.en: What would you like to drink?

lignes.pinyin: wǒ yào yī bēi guǒ zhī
lignes.fr: Je prendrai un jus de fruits.
lignes.en: I'll have a glass of juice.

lignes.zh: 我不喝咖啡，晚上会睡不着。
lignes.pinyin: wǒ bù hē kā fēi wǎn shang huì shuì bù zháo
lignes.fr: Je ne bois pas de café, sinon je ne dors pas la nuit.
lignes.en: I don't drink coffee, or I can't sleep at night.
